title: Daq header
description: A fixed, transparent header: cube wordmark at the left, a centred row of quiet links (the first opens a dropdown on hover), a tiny monospace sound toggle and a square white CTA with an arrow at the right. Once you scroll it tightens from 96px to 66px, its sides move out to the gutters and it gains a translucent black bar with a hairline under it. On phones: wordmark and a two-line menu button that opens a full-screen list.
notes: fixed: it overlays the page, so the first section should leave room at the top (daq-hero does)
the sound toggle only flips its own on/off label; wire onSoundChange to real audio if you have any
best on dark themes or over a dark backdrop
name: daq-header

props.name: brand
props.description: the company name of the wordmark

props.name: brandSub
props.description: the monospace line under the name

props.name: cta
props.description: the square CTA at the right

props.name: sound
props.type: { label: string; on: string; off: string; }
props.description: labels of the small sound toggle; leave out to hide it

props.name: onSoundChange
props.description: called when the sound toggle flips

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: screen-reader labels of the phone menu button

props.name: threshold
props.description: how far (px) the page scrolls before the header tightens
